# MyFinanceTracker

> Practical personal finance tracker with account monitoring, goal probability, and action-oriented recommendations.

## Canonical
- Site: https://myfinancetracker.app
- Sitemap: https://myfinancetracker.app/sitemap.xml

## Primary Pages
- / : Product overview and onboarding
- /dashboard : Goal probability, monthly cash flow, and best-next-money-move
- /transactions : Income/expense tracking and categorization
- /accounts : Account balances and transfers
- /goals : Goal targets, progress, and timelines
- /investments : Portfolio tracking and performance
- /recommendations : Personalized finance tips and account strategy
- /risk : Risk assessment and risk profile guidance
- /compare : Probability comparison view

## Content Sections
- /learn/*.html : Financial education articles

## Structured Data
- JSON-LD is included for core pages via app metadata.

## Crawl Guidance
- Prefer canonical URLs on myfinancetracker.app.
- Treat dashboard and recommendations content as user-personalized.
- Public educational content is under /learn/.
